text: Evening. I'm a foster carer and have a 2 year old girl placed with me. She's had a temperature this evening, 38 when I last took it about twenty minutes ago, I think that's right but the thermometer can be a bit hit and miss. She's also had runny poo, three or four nappies today I'd say, but she's drinking well, water and some milk, and she's weeing normally, nappies are properly wet. Her breathing seems completely normal to me, nothing fast or noisy. She's not drowsy at all, she's sat up on the sofa awake and chatting away, watching her programmes. I'm not overly worried, I just wanted to check whether there's anything particular I should be keeping an eye on overnight, and I need to note advice for her social worker anyway.
